column15: bit 0 = Any alarm / timing / warning; bit 1 = Any trip (latched); bit 2 = CB tripped; bit 3 = CB connected (0 = isolated); bit 4 = CB closed (0 = open); bit 5 = CB undefined; bit 6 = No communication on local bus; bit 7 = Springs charged; bit 8 = Trip command fail; bit 9 = Remote mode (0 = local); bit 10 = Programming OK; bit 11 = Programming failed; bit 12 = Internal bus programming session; bit 13 = Test bus programming session; bit 14 = Local bus programming session; bit 15 = System bus programming session

column7: Cleared by CB reset or trip reset.
column15: bit 0 = L tripped; bit 1 = S tripped; bit 2 = S2 tripped; bit 3 = I tripped (or MCR); bit 4 = Iinst tripped; bit 5 = G tripped; bit 7 = OT tripped; bit 9 = U tripped; bit 10 = UV tripped; bit 11 = OV tripped; bit 13 = RP tripped
0 = Not available; 1 = IA; 2 = IA_2; 3 = IB; 4 = IB_2

column7: Write with the parameter in one function-16 request.
column15: 0 = Dummy; 1 = Trip reset; 2 = Signalling reset; 3 = Communication statistics reset; 4 = Log event reset; 5 = Start programming session; 6 = Abort programming session; 7 = Stop programming session; 8 = CB open; 9 = CB close; 10 = CB reset; 11 = Wink toggle; 12 = History measure reset; 13 = History energy reset; 14 = Datalogger trigger restart; 15 = Datalogger stop
